throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4' --asm 'fst.d $f0, $r20, 0; fst.d $f1, $r20, 8; fst.d $f2, $r20, 16; fst.d $f3, $r20, 24; fst.d $f4, $r20, 32; fst.d $f5, $r20, 40; fst.d $f6, $r20, 48; fst.d $f7, $r20, 56'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: Throughput measured with a 1KB stack buffer. Latency not measured; memory latency depends on cache state.
